note: Zero reader errors occurred in this run (the D-088-fixed engine's headline result for this soak). No reader_errors_total-labeled error counter and no per-(reader,query) error-class counter line appears anywhere in metrics.jsonl -- the harness emits these counters lazily, only once an error fires (soak2/soak3 had hundreds of millions of such lines; this run has none at all), so their total absence here IS the zero, not an artifact of filtering. Confirmed three ways: (1) metrics.jsonl's kind/name enumeration contains no counter named for reader errors (only writer_errors_total exists, for the writer side); (2) every reader-<idx>-progress.json carries "errors": {} (empty) and "error_details": []; (3) longevity_ledger.jsonl's 595 lines are 100% event=writer_op_error -- zero event=reader_op_error lines of any kind, including zero of the D-086 torn-tail StateError class (pre-registration clause (f)).

per_query_counters_summed.description: The per-(reader, query) completed-query counters that an error counter would have been compared against, had any fired (queries_total, gauge-sampled final value per reader x query id; sums to manifest.summary.reader_queries_total=13423132 exactly). These are NOT error counts -- they are provided so the all-zero error claim is checkable against real activity, not against an idle reader.
